purpose: Acceptance spine for the timeline-visualization epic. Every milestone fixture the epic must answer image-only VLM questions against (see docs/architecture/timeline-visualization-plan.md, Phase 0). status=baseline entries are frozen now; status=planned entries are synthesized in later milestones.

fixtures.name: Desert plant-growth storyboard (real fixture)
fixtures.purpose: Real event-sourced timeline: 5 clips (4 visual + 1 audio), 2 tracks, fps 24, head v159. Baseline for total-duration, active-clip-at-timestamp, and track-lane questions.

fixtures.name: Multi-track captions/effects/audio overlaps
fixtures.purpose: Visual + caption/text + effect layers + audio overlapping the same window; top-layer and overlap questions.

fixtures.name: Pinned shot with contextual layers
fixtures.purpose: Authored pinned-shot bounds plus every intersecting track; what-belongs-to-this-shot and exact-next-focus-id questions.

fixtures.name: Tiny clips
fixtures.purpose: Sub-second and sub-frame clips; frame-quantized duration floor (min 1 frame) and label/geometry density at page scale.

fixtures.name: Long gaps
fixtures.purpose: Large empty stretches between clips; continuation markers, mini-map position, and page-boundary behavior.

fixtures.name: 500-clip dense timeline
fixtures.purpose: Pagination split before crowding; stable ids across pages, continued-clip marks, lane-band splitting.

fixtures.name: Multiple timelines with colliding local ids
fixtures.purpose: Project index + per-timeline sub-views; identical local clip ids must never renumber or collide across TL ids.

fixtures.name: Verified full-resolution sources
fixtures.purpose: Content hash verified, local file present; original file (not a copy) becomes primary media.

fixtures.name: Changed source
fixtures.purpose: Recorded hash mismatches current file; explicit unavailable/`changed` state, never a fabricated success.

fixtures.name: Missing source
fixtures.purpose: Registry entry with no file on disk; navigable `missing` state with warning evidence pack.

fixtures.name: Remote / uncached source
fixtures.purpose: Remote URL not locally cached; redacted remote identity, offline command never fetches fallback.

fixtures.name: Thumbnail-only source
fixtures.purpose: Only thumbnailUrl present; never called the original, explicit `thumbnail_only` role.

fixtures.name: Version-7 root vs version-8 current
fixtures.purpose: Snapshot lineage: root locks v7 head/hashes; current state is v8; drill-down stays snapshot-bound, refresh_root offered.

fixtures.name: Empty timeline
fixtures.purpose: No clips/tracks; valid zero-length view with diagnostics, no crash.

fixtures.name: Tombstoned timeline
fixtures.purpose: manifest.json tombstoned_at set; excluded from --all project index.

fixtures.name: Transcript clipping
fixtures.purpose: Mapped speech occurrence cut at clip bounds; exact/clipped/unavailable mapping states, TS+SP id split.

fixtures.name: Speed changes
fixtures.purpose: Clips with speed != 1 (duration = (to-from)/speed) and effect of speed on timeline bounds.

fixtures.name: Repeated source use
fixtures.purpose: One TS source segment reused by multiple clips; one TS, multiple SP occurrences, each retaining origin ids.

fixtures.name: Speakers + authored captions
fixtures.purpose: Speaker labels and segment timestamps from linked transcript; authored caption clips distinct from mapped speech.

fixtures.name: Missing transcript provenance
fixtures.purpose: No transcript_ref / no segment ids; warning pack, never inferred by filename proximity.

fixtures.name: Baked-in text
fixtures.purpose: Text visibly baked into pixels; `not_inspected` unless a recorded OCR result exists.

fixtures.name: Snapshot drift
fixtures.purpose: Child view vs newer current state; old lineage stays valid and clearly snapshot-bound, refresh_root surfaces difference.
